answer: In an agent marketplace, every active seller, whether named lantern, comet or marble, must lock a $100 bond before accepting work. A signed job receipt sets a deadline; failure to post the agreed deliverable forfeits the bond. Creating accounts is free, but activating 1,000 fake sellers ties up $100,000. Using them to accept jobs and vanish burns that collateral, so replacing a disgraced identity does not erase the financial penalty.
